idea: Provide an installable coding skill that maps a small repository change to the narrowest owner-layer tests and records exact local validation state.
mechanism_hypothesis: A reusable skill with explicit ownership, scope, and state-language rules will reduce missed regression checks and false deployment claims relative to the same agent without the skill.
known_non_goals: universal benefit across models and runtimes

lineage.change_summary: Ordinary coding-skill Contract v0 transfer fixture.
